note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Faint vertical lines at roughly 1/3 and 2/3 across the concrete read as stamp or panel seams in the 256 fit view. Concrete tone and frame silhouette otherwise match the original.
flags.fix: Check the libconcrete tile for a seam or joint line at the tile edge. Remove it or cross-fade the wrap seam, then re-run the seam check.

flags.problem: The 1:1 crop shows light, stroke-like streaks that the original mottled olive ground does not have, so it reads closer to dry straw than soft grass in places.
flags.fix: Lower the lab-inject or bright-streak gain on libgrass, or blend more of the colormatched original low-frequency mottling back in, so the streaks sit closer to the original value range.
